text:
Type: round three-tier metal side table
Use: holding plants, a lamp or small items; living room, hallway, bathroom, balcony
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: black powder-coated steel, ridged round metal trays
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: tall narrow round top with two lower round shelves, slim rod legs flaring out at the feet, light and open, small footprint
Feel: graphic, airy, functional, tidy
Goes with: green plants, white walls, wood or concrete; industrial lofts, modern bathrooms and small living rooms
